Title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference For Few Treated Clusters
IDEAS home Printed from https://ideas.repec.org/p/qed/wpaper/1404.html. # Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference For Few Treated Clusters. Although procedures based on the wild cluster bootstrap often work well when the number of treated clusters is not too small, they can either over-reject or under-reject seriously when it is. In a previous paper, we showed that procedures based on randomization inference (RI) can work well in such cases. We propose a bootstrap-based alternative to randomization inference, whichmitigates the discrete nature of RI P values in the few-clusters case. Title: Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference for Few Treated Clusters
IDEAS home Printed from https://ideas.repec.org/p/ags/quedwp/274730.html. # Wild Bootstrap Randomization Inference for Few Treated Clusters. When there are few treated clusters in a pure treatment or difference-in-differences setting, t tests based on a cluster-robust variance estimator (CRVE) can severely over- reject. Although procedures based on the wild cluster bootstrap often work well when the number of treated clusters is not too small, they can either over-reject or under- reject seriously when it is. In a previous paper, we showed that procedures based on randomization inference (RI) can work well in such cases. We propose a bootstrap-based alternative to randomization inference, which mitigates the discrete nature of RI P values in the few-clusters case.
